artifacts.caption: Geographic distribution of the 1,272 USGS national public-supply sites used in the M3.1 benchmark, coloured by aquifer lithology group, with the N = 329 strict reportable subset marked.
artifacts.technical_description: Site coordinates and AqGroup/StudyUnit labels joined from Table_1_Sites.txt (USGS national public-supply release) by site_id; reportability flag taken from the tracerlpm_strict_parity scenario of the regenerated design matrix. State boundaries from geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0) via the geobounds R package, cached offline.
artifacts.interpretation: New in M3.1; M3 had no map figure. Shows the benchmark spans six lithology groups and the continental United States, and that the reportable subset (dots) is a geographically broad, non-clustered sample of the full site set (crosses), i.e. reportability is not concentrated in one region or aquifer type.

artifacts.caption: Atmospheric input histories of tritium, sulfur hexafluoride and chlorofluorocarbon-12 used for young-groundwater residence-time interpretation.
artifacts.technical_description: Recharge-year vs. input-concentration curves generated directly from hydrosheaf.nuclear.input_history.build_default_tritium_input and hydrosheaf.nuclear.multi_tracer.build_atmospheric_tracer_input (current codebase), the same functions the benchmark pipeline uses for tracer prediction.
artifacts.interpretation: Carried over from M3 Figure 1. Shows why the tracer suite must be interpreted jointly: distinct timing and shape give each tracer complementary and non-redundant age sensitivity.

artifacts.caption: Active design-matrix reference agreement and reportability across scenarios, regenerated from current HEAD.
artifacts.technical_description: Median absolute log10 reference discrepancy and within-factor-2 agreement per scenario, point size scaled to the number of identifiable reportable fits. Only scenarios with at least one reportable fit are shown; withdrawn scenarios (hierarchical old-water prior, raw-gas ablation, old-tracer-only) are excluded by the pipeline itself, not by this figure.
artifacts.interpretation: Carried over from M3 Figure 2; regenerated numbers are unchanged from the M3 lock to 15 significant figures (DECISIONS.md D2). Lower discrepancy does not imply field-validated true-age accuracy.

artifacts.caption: Strict reported-configuration emulation against model-derived USGS reference ages, N = 329 reportable subset.
artifacts.technical_description: Log-log scatter of Hydrosheaf emulated age vs. USGS reference age, coloured by age class; dashed lines mark a factor-of-two band. Regenerated from the current-HEAD tracerlpm_strict_parity scenario.
artifacts.interpretation: Carried over from M3 Figure 3. Evaluates reference-workflow agreement, not independently known groundwater ages; agreement is tightest for old/intermediate water and weakest for modern (<=50 yr) water.

artifacts.caption: Graph-age effects on the N = 329 strict reportable nodes: change in RMSE against change in within-factor-2 agreement, one point per candidate family or negative control at each non-zero prior strength.
artifacts.technical_description: Joint-decision scatter (redesigned from M3's small-multiples Figure 4 because a shared-scale RMSE-only view hid the numerically tiny hydraulic-proxy effect). Dashed lines mark zero change on each axis; a robust improvement requires both axes favourable simultaneously.
artifacts.interpretation: Only the hydraulic-proxy family approaches the origin (smallest RMSE change, -0.00135 log10 at weak strength), and even there within-factor-2 agreement still falls (0.875 to 0.869), so it fails the pre-declared joint rule. Every other candidate and both negative controls fall further into the worse-on-both region; wrong-direction and randomised controls are the most harmful, confirming the model responds to imposed topology without validating any candidate as a true flow path.

artifacts.caption: Leakage-guarded target-tracer withholding for 3H, SF6 and 14C: RMSE for the single-node baseline against three candidate/negative-control graphs.
artifacts.technical_description: RMSE computed in Python from per-row cross-validation exports (err = true_val - predicted, RMSE = sqrt(mean(err^2))) over reportable withheld fits only; native tracer units. CFC-11/CFC-12 (zero eligible graph edges) shown separately in Supplementary Figure S3.
artifacts.interpretation: Carried over from M3 Figure 6; regenerated cross-validation results are byte-for-byte identical to the M3 lock for all five tracers (DECISIONS.md D2). No candidate graph shows a meaningful predictive gain over the single-node baseline for any tracer.

artifacts.caption: Exploratory set-valued compatibility audit (development-stage): pairwise tracer infeasibility rates and the rise of local infeasibility with conditioning-set size.
artifacts.technical_description: New in M3.1. Pairwise rates and minimal-infeasible-subset sizes from m3_infeasibility_diagnostics.json at sigma multiplier k=6 (matching docs/m3_identified_ttd_infeasibility_audit_20260731.md Finding 4); conditioning-size table transcribed from that document's Finding 1 and cross-checked against the underlying development CSV's n_conditioning_tracers value counts (exact match: 594/1,626/768/303/138).
artifacts.interpretation: Development-stage/exploratory diagnostic, not the scalar benchmark reported elsewhere in this paper. 27.85% of eligible folds admit no feasible transit-time distribution; the pattern concentrates on within-family tracer pairs (the three CFCs against each other; 3H against 3H/3He) rather than being diffuse. Seven candidate explanations were tested and none accounts for it (Supplementary Information S7); no cause is attributed here.

artifacts.caption: Spatial-distance and vertical-depth-difference distributions for graph edges in the N = 329 strict reportable-node benchmark, by graph family.
artifacts.technical_description: Boxplots of distance_km (pseudo-log scale, handles zero-distance co-located pairs) and depth_diff_m (linear scale, 170 edges with missing depth metadata excluded from that panel only) per family.
artifacts.interpretation: Carried over from M3 Supplementary Figure S2. Diagnoses hypothesised edge geometry, not verified flow connections.

artifacts.caption: CFC-11 and CFC-12 target-withheld RMSE after the reportability guard.
artifacts.technical_description: Same computation as FIG-6, restricted to CFC-11 (4/28 reportable/eligible) and CFC-12 (6/16).
artifacts.interpretation: Carried over from M3 Supplementary Figure S3. No reportable CFC node formed an eligible graph edge, so near-identical bars across variants indicate a non-estimable graph comparison, not equivalence.
